onboard.frontierhunts.task.licence.card: Get a Hunting Licence: 6 tokens at an expedition board, or free after the Archery Range. An unlicensed first deer only earns a warning.
onboard.frontierhunts.task.licence.how: Pass the Archery Range and the Ranger Academy issues a free Hunting Licence, or buy one at an expedition board (Handbook, Journal: Licence & Tags). Big game also needs a tag, game birds a stamp. Under the default Relaxed rules a hunt without one only earns a warning the first time.
onboard.frontierhunts.task.bench.card: Craft a Bow Tuning Rack: three string over planks. String comes from spiders and cobwebs.
onboard.frontierhunts.task.bench.how: Three string over planks (spiders drop string at night; cobwebs give it too). It fits tips to whole stacks and makes bows. No string yet? Skip this step in the Handbook and come back later.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.4.p1: Whitetails live in forests, taiga, groves, meadows, plains and swamps, in small herds. They smell you long before they see you: check the wind with a Wind Checker and walk with the wind in your face.
guide.frontierhunts.lesson.glass.p2: Hold Use with Binoculars to look through them. A Rangefinder tells you how far away the animal is.
guide.frontierhunts.lesson.tips.card: Optional: read the field tips in the Handbook.
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.next.starter: Handbook, field bow and arrows, knives, float rod and an expedition board. The survey only starts once you have them.
onboard.frontierhunts.next.done.body: You know the frontier. Your Journal's Up next always shows what to do next: rewards waiting to be claimed, the next Ranger Academy course, Mara's next mission, contracts and checklist goals.
journal.frontierhunts.home.claim_reserve: Tokens waiting · claim on the Reserve tab
